title: Passage
tagline: A whole life in five minutes.
summary: Jason Rohrer's Passage (2007) is a five-minute game about a lifetime. You walk through a long, narrow world: you can share the way with a spouse, open treasure chests, or explore the maze — and you grow older all the time.
Rohrer released the game's source code and art into the public domain.
This is version 4, with its original graphics and music.

controls.action: Walk (or a gamepad's stick or d-pad)
Start a life from the title
Zoom: smaller, then bigger again, while held
